course.name: Skylit
course.tagline: AI-powered dealer-positioning and options-flow platform for stocks, options and futures, built around the Heatseeker gamma/vanna module.
course.about: Skylit is a trading data and education platform combining real-time market data, options-flow tracking and dealer-positioning analysis (via its Heatseeker module) with live trading rooms and structured courses through Skylit Academy. It integrates seven tools — Heatseeker, Flowseeker, Atlas, Nexus, Tempest, Talon and an API/MCP — led by the platform's founder, known as "Glitch".

curriculum.title: Skylit Academy
topics: Heatseeker: dealer positioning, gamma and vanna exposure
Reading "The King node" and other key price levels
Atlas, Nexus and Tempest: the platform's other data modules
Using Talon, the platform's AI market analyst

formats.label: Real-time market data
formats.description: Millisecond-latency data licensed from NASDAQ, CBOE and OPRA, plus 1+ years of 1-minute session replay.

formats.label: Daily Live Stages
formats.description: Interactive trading rooms with screen sharing and live transcripts.

formats.label: Skylit Academy courses
formats.description: 16 Heatseeker courses and 10 Flowseeker courses covering the platform's modules.

formats.label: 1:1 Trader Success sessions
formats.description: Dedicated support sessions, included on the Pro tier.

pricing.name: Community
pricing.billing_note: Discord, Heatseeker Bot (indices only), Flowseeker, Nexus, Live Stages, pay-as-you-go API.

pricing.name: Initiate
pricing.billing_note: Everything in Community, plus Heatseeker for 63 index/ETF symbols and Atlas for indices and futures.

pricing.name: Pro
pricing.billing_note: Everything in Initiate, plus Heatseeker for 5,000+ tickers, Atlas for all symbols, Talon, Tempest, 100k monthly API credits and 1:1 Trader Success sessions.
